scenarios.title: Product search
scenarios.description: A normal search. No rule matches, so SentinelWeb lets it through and logs it as Normal.

scenarios.title: List products
scenarios.description: A plain page view with no user input.

scenarios.title: Correct login
scenarios.description: A successful login. The password field is never scanned or stored.

scenarios.title: SQL injection
scenarios.description: A classic always-true condition. A fixed rule matches, so it is High severity and blocked in the demo.

scenarios.title: UNION SELECT
scenarios.description: Tries to append a second query that reads another table. Caught by the UNION SELECT rule.

query.q: 1 UNION SELECT username, password FROM users

scenarios.title: Cross-site scripting
scenarios.description: Script-like text that a browser could run if a page showed it unsafely. Caught by an XSS rule.

scenarios.title: Disguised SQL injection
scenarios.description: Written so no fixed rule matches. Only the ML model catches it, so it is flagged for review, not blocked.

scenarios.title: Disguised login bypass
scenarios.description: Another variant the rules miss. The model scores it as similar to known attacks.

scenarios.title: One wrong password
scenarios.description: A single failed login is normal. SentinelWeb records it so repeated attempts can be counted.

scenarios.title: Password guessing
scenarios.description: Five failures in 60 seconds lock the account for 60 seconds. Attempts after that are rejected with 429.

scenarios.title: Request flood
scenarios.description: More than 20 requests in 10 seconds from one client locks that client out for 60 seconds.
